title: Module localization from a lifted tensor comparison
statement: Let $B,C,S,T$ be commutative rings with algebra maps $B\to C$, $B\to S$, $S\to T$. Let $N$ be a $C$-module with its restricted $B$-action and $M$ a $T$-module with its restricted $S$-action. Fix a universe lift $\widetilde S,\widetilde T$ of $S,T$. Let $\kappa:C\to\widetilde T$ and $\phi:C\otimes_B\widetilde S\to\widetilde T$ be ring maps with $\phi(c\otimes1)=\kappa(c)$ and $\phi(1\otimes\operatorname{up}(s))=\operatorname{up}(s\text{ mapped to }T)$. Assume $\phi$ is a localization at some submonoid, in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-localization-of-localization]. Assume there is a $\widetilde T$-linear isomorphism $\widetilde T\otimes_C N\cong M$, where $C\to\widetilde T$ is $\kappa$. Then $L=S\otimes_B N$ admits an $E=S\otimes_B C$ module action compatible with its $S$-action, and there is a submonoid $U$ of $E$ with an $S$-linear isomorphism $U^{-1}L\cong M$.

proof.text: Tensor symmetry and the lift ring equivalence on S transport φ to a localization E → ULift T at the transported submonoid W. Its restrictions to S and C agree with the specified lifted S → T and κ by the two hypotheses on pure tensors, giving the scalar towers.

proof.text: Tensor the localization E → ULift T over C with N. The module localization-tensor theorem makes E tensor over C N → ULift T tensor over C N a localization at W. Precompose with the E-linear version of eL.symm. Its canonical localization isomorphism, restricted to S and composed with the given lifted module equivalence restricted to S, is W⁻¹L ≃ M.

lean.statement:
theorem localizedModule_of_liftedTensorComparison
    (S : Type v) (T : Type w) (B C : Type u) (N : Type t) (M : Type t)
    [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra B C] [Algebra B S] [Algebra S T]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module C N] [Module B N] [IsScalarTower B C N]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module T M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower S T M]
    (κ : C →+* ULift.{z} T)
    (φ : C ⊗[B] ULift.{z} S →+* ULift.{z} T)
    (hφC : ∀ c : C, φ (c ⊗ₜ[B] 1) = κ c)
    (hφS : ∀ s : S, φ (1 ⊗ₜ[B] ULift.up s) = ULift.up (algebraMap S T s))
    (hloc : letI := φ.toAlgebra;
      ∃ U : Submonoid (C ⊗[B] ULift.{z} S), IsLocalization U (ULift.{z} T))
    (hM : letI := κ.toAlgebra; Nonempty (ULift.{z} T ⊗[C] N ≃ₗ[ULift.{z} T] M)) :
    ∃ (_ : Module (S ⊗[B] C) (S ⊗[B] N))
      (_ : IsScalarTower S (S ⊗[B] C) (S ⊗[B] N)) (U : Submonoid (S ⊗[B] C)),
      Nonempty (LocalizedModule U (S ⊗[B] N) ≃ₗ[S] M)
